purpose: Orchestrator-requested sanity check before trusting the full-run verdict: does the Qwen3Reranker adapter, on this exact code path (Qwen3Reranker._compute_scores, bfloat16, real corpus text via DocumentStore), rank a verbatim gold passage above obviously-unrelated passages from other papers?
method: For each trial: score the gold block (verbatim text) plus 3 blocks drawn from other, topically distinct papers against the fixture's own question text, using the same _compute_scores() method the real eval harness calls. Pass criterion (orchestrator's): gold ranks above all 3 unrelated candidates.
conclusion: 2/2 trials pass: gold ranks first both times. But margins over the closest unrelated candidate (0.051, 0.078 on the model's own [0,1] yes-probability scale) are narrow compared to the wide margins on an out-of-domain toy pair tested earlier (Paris/France vs bananas: 0.996 vs 0.0000275, bfloat16) -- the adapter is not broken (correct top-1 twice, real separation from the two weakest negatives), but its resolving power within this specialized safety-research corpus is much smaller than its resolving power on an easy, generic pair. This is consistent with, and does not contradict, the aggregate finding: real but much weaker signal than the shipped BGE cross-encoder.
